news.headline: Far-right AfD wins crushing victory in German state election
news.summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) surged into first place in state elections in Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday, exit polls showed, putting it within reach of power at the state level for the first time since World War Two, though falling just short of an overall majority.

news.headline: Probe begins into why cargo plane overran Miami runway
news.summary: Five people died and five others were injured as the Amazon plane overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport.
